تستعطفوا (form X)
# تَسْتَعْطِفُوا (tastaʕṭifū) /tas.taʕ.tˤi.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْطَفَ (istaʕṭafa)
# تُسْتَعْطَفُوا (tustaʕṭafū) /tus.taʕ.tˤa.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْطَفَ (istaʕṭafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
